title: Geographical and ethnic variation of the 677C>T allele of 5,10 methylenetetrahydrofolate reductase (MTHFR): findings from over 7000 newborns from 16 areas world wide
authors: Wilcken B, Bamforth F, Li Z, Zhu H, Ritvanen A, Redlund M, et al.
population: Newborns sampled from screening programmes and birth hospitals in 16 areas of Europe, Russia, Israel, China, Australia and the Americas, under the International Clearinghouse for Birth Defect Monitoring Systems
funder: The study was supported in part by grant U50/CCU207141 from the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. The work by Generoso Andria (Napoli) was partially supported by grants from CNR Rome.
result: TT homozygosity: Mexico 32.2%, Campania 26.4%, Sicily 20.1%, northern Han China 19.8%, southern Han China 8.1%, Spanish whites 11.8%, Hungary 11.1%, Atlanta whites 10.7%, Atlanta Hispanics 17.7%, Atlanta blacks 2.7%, Australian whites 8.0%, Russia 7.0%, the Netherlands 6.4%, Alberta whites 5.8%, Helsinki 4.0%. CT heterozygosity was 20% in Atlanta blacks and 34% to 53% in the other main groups. T allele frequency 12.6% (Atlanta blacks) to 57.0% (Mexico).
